title: Track
intro: Your own location history from TravTrack, day by day — for you only, never shared.

day.label: Day
day.empty: Nothing was recorded on this day.
day.truncated: This day holds more positions than one view shows — the line is incomplete.

timeline.title: The day
timeline.none: TravStats knows of no flight, no trip and no time at home on this day.

zones.legend: Your privacy zones are drawn as circles; nothing is recorded inside them.

export.title: Export the history
export.intro: Downloads your TravTrack positions of these days, both included, on your profile's clock. What a privacy zone hides is not in the file.
export.gpx: GPX — for map and sports apps
export.json: JSON — everything, with pauses and deleted spans
export.truncated: This span holds more positions than one file carries. Part {{part}} is downloaded — “Export the rest” downloads the next part.
export.doneParts: All {{count}} parts were downloaded — together, the whole span.
export.truncatedNoRest: The file ends early, and the server does not say where the rest begins. Export a shorter span.

delete.title: Delete a span
delete.intro: Deletes every position of these days, both included, on your profile's clock. The span stays deleted: not even a phone that was still offline brings them back. Flights and trips stay.
delete.previewNone: Nothing is stored in this span.

errors.disabled: TravTrack is switched off on this server. What is stored can still be exported and deleted under Settings → Location.
errors.exportTooLong: An export covers at most 366 days. Pick a shorter span.
errors.zoneLimit: You already have as many privacy zones as there can be.
errors.network: The server cannot be reached right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.generic: That did not work. Try again.

settings.intro: The positions your Companion records for TravTrack live here on your server – for you only, never shared or federated. They stay until you delete them.
settings.off: TravTrack is switched off on this server: nothing more is recorded. What is stored you can still export and delete here.
settings.loadFailed: TravTrack could not be loaded. Reload the page.
settings.summary: {{count}} positions stored, from {{from}} to {{to}}, from {{devices}} device(s).

zones.title: Privacy zones
zones.intro: Inside a privacy zone nothing is recorded at all: the app sends no position from there, and the server drops it there too. The zones apply to all your devices.
zones.name: Name
zones.centreHint: Coordinates or a Google Maps link, e.g. 52.5200, 13.4050
zones.addedDeleted: Privacy zone added, {{count}} stored positions inside it deleted.
zones.confirmTitle: Delete the positions inside the zone?
zones.confirmMessage: {{count}} stored positions already lie inside this zone. Adding the zone deletes them – this cannot be undone.
zones.notSaved: The privacy zone was not saved. Try again.
zones.removeConfirm: Remove the privacy zone “{{name}}”? Recording resumes there; what the zone deleted stays deleted.
zones.notRemoved: The privacy zone was not removed. Try again.

delete.title: Delete a span
delete.intro: Deletes every position of these days, both included, on your profile's clock. The span stays deleted: not even a phone that was still offline brings them back.
delete.confirm: Delete all {{count}} positions from {{from}} to {{to}}? This cannot be undone.
delete.notDone: The positions were not deleted. Try again.
